subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.

_________ your clothes, it is high time you clean up the mess in your room.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Fold" **means to bend something flexible and lay it over itself, often for the purpose of making it more compact. (मोड़ना)

 
 
• **Example: **Please** fold **your clothes and put them away.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word to fill in the blank is **"Fold"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Fold**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Faux **(नकली): Artificial or imitation; not genuine.

 
 
• **Example:** She wore a faux fur coat to the party.
 
 
 
• **Foaled **(घोड़ी का बच्चा जनना): The act of a mare giving birth to a foal.
 
 
• **Example: **The mare foaled in the early hours of the morning.
 
 
 
• **Fouled **(गंदा करना): To make something dirty or polluted.
 
 
• **Example: **The river was fouled by industrial waste.
 
 

39:Td55,

The correct answer is: Option 1.</b&
